description: After the host reviews and explicitly approves the exact migration batch, save its unpublished event drafts and apply its reviewed community images on their account and owned community. Requires jobId and current reviewHash from prepare_host_migration review and get_host_migration. Refuses stale reviews, unresolved events and other owners. Background work is inspectable and retries never overwrite imported events. Does not publish, send invitations, migrate money or grant communication consent.
name: commit_host_migration
title: Commit Host Migration
